8k_detail.extracto: Item 7.01 Regulation FD Disclosure. On November 10, 2026, Acrivon Therapeutics, Inc. (the Company ) hosted a webcast corporate R&D event with Eosinophilic esophagitis (EoE) Key Opinion Leaders to discuss Acrivon s new immunology and inflammation (I&I) programs, acquired using its AI-driven AP3 platform. The webcast took place from approximately 4:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. ET. The agenda featured a presentation by the Company s leadership team introducing the ACR-525 and PK C inhibitor preclinical programs and initial development plans in EoE, followed by an overview of EoE epidemiology and unmet need by Dr. Arjan Bredenoord (principal investigator and professor, Gastroenterology and Hepatology, Amsterdam University Medical Center) , a review of EoE standard of care by Dr. Evan Dellon (professor, Department of Medicine, Division of Gastroenterology and Hepatology and Director, Center for Esophageal Diseases and Swallowing, School of Medicine, University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill), and an interactive Q&A session and discussion. In connection with this event, the Company posted to the Investors & Media section of the Company s website at ir.acrivon.com, the presentation used in the event (the Presentation ). A copy of the Presentation is attached hereto as Exhibit 99.1 and is incorporated by reference into this Item 7.01 of this Current Report on Form 8-K.
